annotations.title: NY maximum and minimum weekly benefit

description: The New York maximum and minimum weekly workers' compensation benefit for a date of accident (the rate year runs July 1 to June 30; the maximum is fixed by the date of accident, never by today's date). Use for "what is the max rate for a 2025 injury". New York State only. Computes with The Comp Desk calc-core (the engine behind the app, the website calculators and the Pro Workspace); it never estimates. If an input is missing it returns status "missing" with every input still needed and calculates nothing. Returns the figures, the rate year used, the formulas with their citations (each flagged with whether it has been attorney-reviewed), and the not-legal-advice notice.

date_of_accident.description: Date of accident (injury), YYYY-MM-DD. Only a full date the user gave; never a guessed one.
